International Stage Lab. (ISL) is a joint programme run by NO Tiyatro and Vajra Theatre. Together, the two organisations bring tutors and artists from international drama schools together with performers across a network that reaches from Türkiye to Europe, designing and delivering workshops, camps and summer schools side by side.

Vajra Theatre is an independent performing arts initiative founded by Karen Yazel Yivli in January 2025. Karen Yazel Yivli graduated in Acting from the Theatre Department of Ankara University’s Faculty of Languages, History and Geography in 2023, and has since developed her stage practice internationally through festivals and training programmes in the UK, Italy and Türkiye.
Vajra Theatre’s annual training programme is built on the real needs of actors, directors and performers from Türkiye to Europe. Each workshop is designed with the invited tutor around those needs.

Its long-term aim is a lasting structure that runs from training to production: creating theatre projects and plays on an international scale, nurturing its own writers and directors, and using its international connections to make creative work in Türkiye and across Europe. Beyond organising workshops, Vajra Theatre aims to build a performing arts community that creates, learns and shares.
